description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering search parameters related to likes on comments in the Buzz module of OrangeHRM. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sorting fields. It includes a comment ID property with getter and setter methods, setting default sort field in constructor.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering search results related to comment likes in the Buzz module, with selectable sort fields and an optional comment ID filter.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field.

methods.name: getCommentId
methods.description: Returns the comment ID filter value, if set.

methods.name: setCommentId
methods.description: Sets the comment ID filter value.
